title: Climate downscaling with likelihood functional flow matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.33482v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decisions about heat, frost and flooding are made locally, yet reanalyses and climate models resolve tens of kilometres. Generative downscalers add kilometre-scale detail with uncertainty, but are tied to a grid, costly to sample and lack a tractable likelihood. Here we introduce CD-FFM, a functional flow-matching model that treats the high-resolution field as a continuous random field that one model can query at any location and resolution. Its velocity acts pointwise, so spatial variability comes from a noise prior fitted to the observed spectrum and every observation has an exact likelihood. Downscaling ERA5 to 1 km daily temperature over Fennoscandia, CD-FFM lowers the continuous ranked probability score by 27-31% against regression and 12-18% against a forty-times larger neural operator in each of three test years, and outperforms a CorrDiff-style diffusion model while sampling about fifty times faster. translated_title: 基于似然泛函流匹配的气候降尺度
translated_abstract: 关于高温、霜冻和洪水的决策是在局地层面做出的，然而再分析资料和气候模型的分辨率仅为数十公里。生成式降尺度方法能够添加公里尺度的细节并量化不确定性，但其受限于固定网格、采样成本高昂且缺乏可处理的似然函数。在此我们提出CD-FFM，一种泛函流匹配模型，它将高分辨率场视为连续随机场，单个模型即可在任意位置和分辨率进行查询。其速度场逐点作用，因此空间变率来自拟合观测谱的噪声先验，且每个观测都具有精确的似然。在将ERA5降尺度至芬诺斯堪的纳维亚地区1公里日温度的实验中，在三个测试年份的每一年里，CD-FFM相比回归方法将连续排序概率评分（CRPS）降低了27-31%，相比参数量大四十倍的神经算子降低了12-18%，同时优于CorrDiff风格的扩散模型，采样速度快约五十倍。同一模型可迁移至p（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出泛函流匹配模型CD-FFM，将高分辨率气候场视为可在任意位置和分辨率查询、且具有精确似然的连续随机场，在芬诺斯堪的纳维亚1公里日温度降尺度任务上显著优于回归方法、大型神经算子和扩散模型，采样速度快约五十倍。
en_tdlr: CD-FFM, a functional flow-matching model that treats high-resolution climate fields as continuous random fields queryable at any location and resolution with exact likelihoods, outperforms regression, a 40x larger neural operator, and diffusion models for 1 km temperature downscaling while sampling about fifty times faster.
